## Source
.design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md — decomposition PR 8.

## Surface
- `polaris-ozone-import/tests/fixtures/ozone-dump-v1.sql` — anonymized Ozone dump
- Generation script `polaris-ozone-import/tests/fixtures/generate-fixture.rs` or `make ozone-fixture`
- Fixture contents: at minimum 100 subjects, 500 reports, 200 moderation events covering every Ozone event kind Polaris maps. All identifiers anonymized (DIDs become `did:plc:test_*`).

## Rust-quality notes
- Fixture data is CHECKED INTO the repo so CI is hermetic — no external download. Size: aim for <5MB compressed.
- The generation script is reproducible: same seed → same fixture. Per rust-quality §7: deterministic test data is non-negotiable.
- Fixture covers every documented mapping rule (every Ozone event kind, every Subject kind, every Action kind in the Polaris enum).
- Fixture is **blessed by an actual Ozone operator** before being canonized — without operator review, the fixture can't catch real-world quirks. Document the review process in `tests/fixtures/README.md`.

## External references
- Ozone schema source: https://github.com/bluesky-social/atproto/tree/main/packages/ozone/src/db/schema
- `rand::SeedableRng` for deterministic test data: https://docs.rs/rand/latest/rand/trait.SeedableRng.html

## Acceptance
- [ ] `tests/fixtures/ozone-dump-v1.sql` exists, <5MB, covers every mapping rule.
- [ ] CI uses the fixture to run AC-1 through AC-5 verifications.
- [ ] `tests/fixtures/README.md` documents the operator-review process.

- Closes the epic. On approval, close #132 with `--kind result`.
